user.title: FusionSolar account
user.description: Use the account of the FusionSolar app. The subdomain is the first part of the address shown in your browser once logged in to FusionSolar, for example uni004eu5.

captcha.title: Security code
captcha.description:
Huawei asks for a security code. Type the characters shown below.

![captcha]({captcha_url})

reauth_confirm.title: Log in again
reauth_confirm.description: The FusionSolar session for {username} has ended. Enter the password; a security code may follow.

error.invalid_auth: Username or password refused by FusionSolar.
error.invalid_captcha: Wrong code, a new one is shown.

abort.no_chargers: No charger was found on this account.

init.title: Options
init.description: Commands write to the real charger through the FusionSolar cloud. They are off by default.

data.enable_control: Enable commands (start, stop, schedule, working mode)
data.control_interval: Working mode and schedule update interval (seconds)

auth_failed.message: The FusionSolar login needs your attention (password or security code). Open Settings > Devices & services.

control_disabled.message: Commands are disabled in the integration options.

not_confirmed.message: The charger did not confirm the change: {reason}
